method.geometry: Evaluated flexible rootkink blade meshes in the contemporaneous YawRoot frame
method.point_containment: Three non-axis-aligned ray parity votes per endpoint for closed manifold surfaces
method.segment_intersection: BVH ray intersection on the anchor-to-optical-centre segment, plus endpoint containment
method.segment_distance_bound: 81 equally spaced nodes; minimum node distance minus half node spacing, using the 1-Lipschitz surface distance bound

scope: Finite saved-motion samples of nine blade meshes, ideal optical point and zero-radius installation segment; not continuous swept-volume clearance, camera/bracket volume clearance, physical certification or an installation safety limit.
